facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Hans worked for seven years. His boss gave him gold. He was very happy. Hans got gold.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans was a young man who worked hard for seven years. When his work was done, his master gave him payment. Hans got gold, a lump as big as his head. He was so happy and excited to go home to Mother. He put the heavy gold on his shoulder and started walking. But the gold was very heavy and the road was very long.
facts.Word cards: traded = 교환했다 / gold = 금 / home = 집 / happy = 행복한
